checks.detail: Admission Transaction applies selected outcomes and cannot select them.
Decision Bundle is the closed authorization input; Admission Transaction is its atomic application.
Decision Checkpoint is the human interaction position and has no application authority.
Agent Action records attributable work; Admission Transaction has a specific governance application contract.
Project State is a deterministic consequence and remains a separate artifact identity.

claim_ceiling: This audit checks candidate semantic distinctions only and changes no admitted Definition or consumer.
